title: Check Symmetric Tree
question: How do you check if a binary tree is symmetric (a mirror of itself) in Java?
realWorldScenario: Recursive: compare left.left with right.right and left.right with right.left simultaneously.

title: Invert Binary Tree
question: How do you invert (mirror) a binary tree in Java?
realWorldScenario: Swap left and right subtrees at every node recursively. O(n) time and O(h) space.

title: Same Tree Check
question: How do you check if two binary trees are identical (same structure and values)?
realWorldScenario: Recursive: both null → true; one null → false; values differ → false; else recurse on both children.

title: Subtree Check
question: How do you check if one binary tree is a subtree of another (LeetCode 572)?
searchIntent: subtree of another tree java interview
realWorldScenario: At each node in the main tree, call isSameTree(node, subRoot). O(n·m) where n and m are tree sizes.

title: Count Complete Tree Nodes
question: How do you count nodes in a complete binary tree more efficiently than O(n)?
searchIntent: count complete tree nodes java interview
realWorldScenario: Compare left and right heights; if equal, left subtree is perfect — use 2^h formula. Else recurse. O(log² n).

title: Leaf Similar Trees
question: How do you check if two binary trees have the same leaf value sequence?
realWorldScenario: Collect leaf values from both trees via DFS into lists; compare the two lists.
